notes: PRICING: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/14289835-topstep-pricing-and-payment-questions. Base USD monthly subscriptions: Standard 49/99/199 and No Activation Fee 95/149/229 at 50K/100K/150K. Standard activation 149 once per earned XFA; other path zero. Paths cannot be changed after purchase. Taxes may be added. https://www.topstep.com/topstep-prop confirms rebilling until passing or cancellation.

RISK: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284204-what-is-the-maximum-loss-limit. Tier maxLossUsd is 2000/3000/4500, not a uniform percentage: maxLossPct stays null. End-of-day trailing, locks at starting balance, monitored intraday including unrealised P&L; touching the limit is a breach. XFA starts at zero and first payout sets MLL to zero. Dollar tier limits allow the shared true-cost helper to compute a tier-specific risk multiple.

TARGET: https://www.topstep.com/topstep-prop. Profit targets 3000/6000/9000 at 50000/100000/150000 equal 6% in each case (normalisation, not a separately quoted percentage). The Combine is one evaluation stage before simulated XFA; Live is a separate progression.

DAILY LIMIT: https://www.topstep.com/topstep-prop. Optional 1000/2000/3000 dollar DLL, not a mandatory percentage or zero loss cap. dailyLossPct remains null. It stops trading until the next session. The pricing article gives No Activation Fee discounts of 10/20/30 recurring monthly, resulting in 85/129/199 before tax. Discount eligibility and opting into the lockout matter.

MINIMUM DAYS CONFLICT: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284197-trading-combine-parameters says as few as two days, while https://www.topstep.com/topstep-prop says no minimum time requirement. Both statements remain visible at capture. minTradingDays is null: do not turn a conflicting claim into a verified two-day or zero-day filter. maxTradingDays is null; the subscription continues until pass/cancel, not a prepaid unlimited-duration fee.

CONSISTENCY: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284208-consistency-at-topstep, rechecked 2026-10-06. Combine best day must not exceed 55%; exceeding it raises the required profit target. There is no buffer. Funded XFA Consistency remains 40%, with three trading days. The parameters article and marketing cards also show 55%. This is an observation date, not an established effective date.

PAYOUT REQUEST: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284233-topstep-payout-policy. XFA Standard requires 5 winning trading days of at least 150 USD and positive net profit since the last payout (first exempt). XFA Consistency requires 3 trading days with at least one trade each and best day at most 40% of total net profit. payoutFirstDays=null because one calendar-day scalar cannot represent both conditional trading-day routes. payoutFrequency is 'after-qualifying-days' (re-read 2026-10-26, article updated 2026-10-13): "Express Funded Account Standard To request a Payout, you must meet both requirements: 5 winning days of $150+ Net P&L. Days don't need to be consecutive." / "Express Funded Account Consistency To request a Payout, you must meet both requirements: 3 trading days with at least 1 trade per day. Stay at or below the 40% consistency target." / "After you request a Payout, your winning day count restarts. You'll need 5 new winning days before you're eligible to request your next Payout." Daily requests unlock only in the Live Funded Account: "Once you've earned $150+ Net P&L on 30 non-consecutive days in your Live Funded Account, you unlock daily Payouts". Eligible requests are made during CME market hours.

PAYOUT AMOUNTS: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284233-topstep-payout-policy. Minimum request 125 USD, standard share 90%. Maximum request is 50% of balance, with Standard/Consistency base caps 2000/3000 at 50K, 3000/4000 at 100K, 5000/6000 at 150K. Limited-time double caps require adding DLL when purchasing a new Combine; adding it at XFA activation/reactivation alone does not qualify. Legacy dashboard entrants before 2026-01-12 retain first 10000 lifetime profits at 100%, then 90/10.

TRANSFER TIMING: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284233-topstep-payout-policy. Approval can take 1-3 business days separately from transfer. Prop-to-Brokerage: US only, same day if before noon CT, no fee. Aeropay: US banks, instant after approval if bank supports real-time payments (otherwise 1-3 business days), no Topstep fee. Wise: China/Canada/UK only, 1-3 business days, no Topstep fee. ACH: US banks, 1-3 business days, 30 USD. Wire/SWIFT: international, 5-10 business days, 30 USD. Third-party fees may apply; estimates exclude weekends/holidays. No independent payout receipt was verified.

HOURS AND INSTRUMENTS: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284206-when-and-what-products-can-i-trade. Futures only, CME/COMEX/NYMEX/CBOT; flat by 15:10 CT or earlier product close, reopen 17:00 CT, Friday flat until Sunday. No overnight/weekend holding. FX futures are not spot forex; crypto futures are not spot crypto.

NEWS AND AUTOMATION: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/10305426-prohibited-trading-strategies-at-topstep prohibits full maximum-size entries into scheduled major news, unfair technology and SIM exploitation. https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284197-trading-combine-parameters permits automated strategies subject to conditions and gives no malfunction exceptions. Both pricing paths therefore use restricted EA flags; a higher subscription price grants no extra permission.

COPY TRADING: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/14434175-topstepx. Copier available in Combine and XFA, not Live; Lead account must have lowest maximum position size in group, and scaling differences may disconnect copying. Both pricing paths use restricted flags, not blanket permission.

RESET AND REFUND: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/14289835-topstep-pricing-and-payment-questions. Reset prices equal monthly price for each path (including 95 USD for No Activation Fee 50K, now legible). Monthly rebill includes reset credit per https://www.topstep.com/topstep-prop. https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284197-trading-combine-parameters allows refund review only for unused purchases within 28 days when changing size; refundable=false denotes no earned fee-refund benefit, not denial of every statutory or unused-purchase refund.

BACK2FUNDED: https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/12060405-back2funded-rules-guidelines-and-how-it-works. 599/699/829 USD base reactivation fees, up to two per eligible XFA before first payout; 50 USD DLL discount conditional. The dedicated article explicitly dates the 7-to-30-calendar-day window change to 2026-05-29, corroborated by https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/14289835-topstep-pricing-and-payment-questions. Older 7-day wording is superseded for this specified programme, not an unresolved equal-weight rule.

HISTORICAL STATISTICS: https://www.topstep.com/topstep-prop. Firm-published 2025 results still show 16.8% of Combines completed, 51.8% of participants advanced at least once, 33.3% of funded participants received payout, 0.71% of XFA traders called to Live. Historical cohorts, not our forecasts or independently audited outcomes.

XFA CONSISTENCY ROUTE (read 2026-10-20): https://help.topstep.com/en/articles/8284233-topstep-payout-policy (dateModified 2026-10-13). Payout path chosen at XFA activation (8284215). Consistency path: "3 trading days with at least 1 trade per day" and "Your largest single day cannot exceed 40% of your total net profit"; max request 50% of balance up to $3,000/$4,000/$6,000 at 50K/100K/150K, doubled to $6,000/$8,000/$12,000 only if a DLL was added when buying a new Trading Combine (limited-time offer from 2 June). Standard path: 5 winning days of $150+, caps $2,000/$3,000/$5,000. Live payouts uncapped.
